stem.text: Vertically polarised light of intensity $I_0$ is incident normally on a polarising filter.
The transmission axis of the filter is at an angle $\theta$ to the plane of polarisation of the light.
The intensity of the light after passing through the filter is $\dfrac{I_0}{3}$.

stem.alt: Light ray passing through a square polarising filter drawn at an angle, with arrows and a dashed line inside the filter; labelled light intensity I0, direction of transmission axis, θ and light intensity I0/3.
